Dubai Airport Traffic Falls But Shows Signs of Recovery Amid Iran War

The airport expects to handle more than 70 million passengers this year, compared with a record 95.2 million in 2025

By

DOHA, Qatar-Passenger traffic at Dubai International Airport fell 22.1% in the third quarter from a year earlier as the Iran war continued to disrupt Gulf aviation, although volumes recovered sharply from the previous quarter as airlines restored services.

Dubai International, one of the world’s busiest aviation hubs, handled 18.8 million passengers during the quarter, up from 13 million in the second quarter. Traffic reached 6.6 million in August, the busiest month of the quarter, according to Dubai Airports.
